title: Weighted acceptance string
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols, let $c,B,e$ be natural numbers, and let $x$ be a Boolean string. Define the weighted acceptance string for $x$ by applying the machine’s choice weights to the paired data extracted from the bounded dynamic-programming run of $N$ on $x$, and summing the resulting weighted strings.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
